The '''''Retaliation''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Maarisa Zsinj]].

==History==
At some point after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Retaliation'' was scheduled for decommissioning, with Maarisa's son [[Zsinj]] moving to take command of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] instead.

Maarisa Zsinj refused to hand her ship over and instead ventured on a new career as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], targeting what she saw as a corrupt [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Her son was ordered to take her down, which resulted in a military campaign that ended with Maarisa's death and the younger Zsinj proclaimed as the first [[Warlord of the Empire]].
